# Documentation Organization Guide

> **Purpose:** This guide explains how SysDocs documentation is organized to maintain a single source of truth and avoid duplication.

## Core Principle: Single Source of Truth

**Data lives in one place only:**
- ✅ Auto-generated reports contain current data (regenerate don't edit)
- ✅ Manual documents contain policy/procedures (reference reports, don't copy data)
- ❌ Never duplicate data between documents

## 📊 Auto-Generated Reports (Never Manually Edit)

**Header marker:** `> ⚠️ **AUTO-GENERATED FILE - DO NOT MANUALLY EDIT**`

| File | Generated By | Contains | Regenerate When |
|------|-------------|----------|----------------|
| [../reports/LICENSE_COMPLIANCE.md](../reports/LICENSE_COMPLIANCE.md) | `dotnet run --project tests/SysDocs.Tests -- --license-compliance` | Package names, versions, specific licenses | Dependencies change |
| [../reports/TEST_TRACEABILITY.md](../reports/TEST_TRACEABILITY.md) | `dotnet run --project tests/SysDocs.Tests -- --traceability` | Test counts, requirement mapping, coverage stats | Tests/requirements change |

**Rules:**
- ⚠️ **NEVER** manually edit these files
- ✅ **ALWAYS** regenerate when data changes
- ✅ Commit regenerated files for review

## 📝 Manual Documentation (Human Maintained)

**Header marker:** `> 📝 **MANUAL DOCUMENTATION**`

| File | Contains | Update When |
|------|----------|-------------|
| [LICENSE_COMPLIANCE_SUMMARY.md](LICENSE_COMPLIANCE_SUMMARY.md) | Approved licenses, audit schedule, procedures | Policy changes |
| [VV_SETUP_SUMMARY.md](VV_SETUP_SUMMARY.md) | V&V system guide, test commands | V&V process changes |
| [DETERMINISTIC_BUILDS.md](DETERMINISTIC_BUILDS.md) | Nix build guide, verification | Build system changes |
| [WINDOWS_BUILD.md](WINDOWS_BUILD.md) | Windows/WSL2 setup instructions | Platform requirements change |
| [DETERMINISTIC_BUILD_SUMMARY.md](DETERMINISTIC_BUILD_SUMMARY.md) | Build system implementation summary | Major build changes |
| [../project/VERIFICATION_VALIDATION.md](../project/VERIFICATION_VALIDATION.md) | V&V strategy, acceptance criteria | Methodology changes |
| [../project/REQUIREMENTS.md](../project/REQUIREMENTS.md) | System requirements | New requirements |
| [../project/TRACEABILITY.md](../project/TRACEABILITY.md) | Traceability strategy | Traceability process changes |
| [../project/CONTRIBUTING.md](../project/CONTRIBUTING.md) | Contribution guidelines | Development process changes |

**Rules:**
- ✅ Edit when policies or processes change
- ✅ Reference auto-generated reports (don't copy data)
- ❌ **NEVER** duplicate data from reports

## 🎯 Quick Reference

### "What licenses do we use?"
```bash
# Generate fresh data
dotnet run --project tests/SysDocs.Tests -- --license-compliance

# Read the report
cat reports/LICENSE_COMPLIANCE.md
```

### "Which requirements have tests?"
```bash
# Generate fresh data
dotnet run --project tests/SysDocs.Tests -- --traceability

# Read the report
cat reports/TEST_TRACEABILITY.md
```

### "What's the license policy?"
```bash
# Read the manual guide (no regeneration needed)
cat docs/LICENSE_COMPLIANCE_SUMMARY.md
```

## 🔄 Maintenance Workflows

### Adding a Dependency
```bash
dotnet add package SomePackage
dotnet run --project tests/SysDocs.Tests -- --license-compliance
git add src/**/*.csproj reports/LICENSE_COMPLIANCE.md
```

### Adding a Test
```bash
# Edit test file
dotnet run --project tests/SysDocs.Tests -- --traceability
git add tests/ reports/TEST_TRACEABILITY.md
```

### Updating Policy
```bash
# Edit manual doc (e.g., LICENSE_COMPLIANCE_SUMMARY.md)
# No report regeneration needed
git add docs/LICENSE_COMPLIANCE_SUMMARY.md
```

## 🚨 Common Mistakes

❌ Editing auto-generated files manually  
✅ Regenerating them with commands

❌ Copying data into summaries  
✅ Referencing reports: "see LICENSE_COMPLIANCE.md"

❌ Committing without regenerating reports  
✅ Regenerating when dependencies/tests change

## 📋 Testable vs Non-Testable

### Code Can Test (Auto-Generated)
- NuGet package licenses
- Test-to-requirement mapping
- Dependency counts
- Test pass/fail status

### Code Cannot Test (Manual Documentation)
- Nix system dependencies (requires `nix eval`)
- Business policy decisions
- Risk assessments
- Human processes
- Legal interpretations
